title: Grand Theft Auto VI Inspires Holiday Display at Laredo Home
excerpt: A home in Las Misiones, off Highway 359 in east Laredo, is drawing attention for a holiday display built around Grand Theft Auto VI — colorful lights and a poster for the game that fans have waited 13 years to play. The game launches Thursday, Nov. 19.
content:
A home in Las Misiones, off Highway 359 in east Laredo, is drawing attention for a holiday display built around Grand Theft Auto VI — colorful lights and a poster for the game that fans have waited 13 years to play.

A viewer shared a video of the display in a gaming group, and it caught on, spreading the word about the house. People are welcome to drive by and take a picture, and the display may inspire similar ones elsewhere in town.

The report did not name the homeowner or give the street address — only the neighborhood, Las Misiones, off Highway 359 in east Laredo.

The timing is no accident: Grand Theft Auto VI launches Thursday, Nov. 19, after a 13-year wait since the last main entry in the series. Webb Watch previously reported on the game’s launch and its eight Game Awards nominations.

Sources: GTA VI holiday display report, Nov. 18, 2026.
